changelog:
Initial release of the verbs-to-urma-converter skill.

- Enables full migration of RDMA Verbs (libibverbs) applications to the URMA API.
- Handles API mapping, data structure conversion, and URMA-specific optimizations.
- Enforces multi-phase, constraint-driven migration workflow for correctness:
  - Source classification, mapping, and header verification.
  - File-by-file code conversion with mapping traceability.
  - Build configuration updates to support URMA libraries.
- Includes strict verification and checklist mechanisms to avoid omissions and runtime errors.
- Preserves original files by outputting all converted code to a separate directory.
